mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Halana and Alena, Partners: "First strike, reach. At the beginning of combat on your turn, put X
# +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control, where X is Halana and Alena's power. That
# creature gains haste until end of turn."
# Event: Dire Fleet Warmonger's verified "beginning of combat on your turn". Effect: Feat of
# Resistance's counters on "target creature you control" with "another" (FNot(IS_SOURCE), Subira's
# "another target creature"), the count the source's power (QProp('source', POWER), Goblin Arsonist's
# "its power" family); then "that creature" is the ability's target, the compiler's "Untap that
# creature." referent ('target'), with Traitorous Greed's haste until end of turn.
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.COMBAT,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
                'count': QProp(referent='source', field=QPropField.POWER),
                'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
                'target': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                            FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                ),
            }),
            A(Verb.GRANT_ABILITY, {
                'ability': KeywordAbility(keyword=Keyword.HASTE),
                'duration': DurationEot(),
                'target': Selector(
                    count=QConst(value=1),
                    mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                    zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                    referent='target',
                ),
            }),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Reach (This creature can block creatures with flying.)
First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)
At the beginning of combat on your turn, put X +1/+1 counters on another target creature you control, where X is Halana and Alena's power.
That creature gains haste until end of turn.

mapping.notes: Beginning of combat on your turn; PUT_COUNTER count QProp('source', POWER) on another target creature you control; 'That creature' is the compiler's 'Untap that creature.' referent ('target') with haste until end of turn.
